channel.title: InfraGraph Asia
channel.description: Verified Asia infrastructure project and event intelligence.

item.title: Yunlin Offshore Wind Farm enters full commercial operation at 640 MW
item.description: All 80 turbines are grid-connected, and the project has moved into its operations and maintenance phase.

item.title: Ningxia-Hunan 8 GW UHVDC link enters full operation
item.description: The 1,616 km, +/-800 kV transmission project connects renewable-rich Ningxia with the load centre of Hunan.

item.title: Waratah Super Battery begins partial operation with 350 MW online
item.description: The initial 350 MW / 700 MWh entered service as part of an 850 MW / 1,680 MWh system designed to support the New South Wales grid.

item.title: AWS launches Thailand cloud region with three Availability Zones
item.description: AWS said the new region operates from three Availability Zones and is backed by a planned investment of more than US$5 billion in Thailand.

item.title: Microsoft announces US$1.7 billion cloud and AI investment in Indonesia
item.description: The four-year commitment covers new cloud and AI infrastructure, skills programmes and support for Indonesia's developer community.

item.title: YTL Power and NVIDIA announce 500 MW AI data centre collaboration in Malaysia
item.description: The planned AI infrastructure was announced for YTL's green data centre park in Kulai, Johor.
